text:
Priya: incident-bot just paged SRE-Oncall — GPU pool for prod-region-1 is at 98% utilization and the requests queue is spiking (pending pods ~412). autoscaler keeps logging failures when creating nodes.
incident-bot: PAGED SRE-Oncall — severity: high. alert: gpu.queue_growth > 90% for 6m, autoscaler.create_node_errors > 5/min.
James: seeing AttachRoleDenied and LaunchTemplateVersionMismatch in the autoscaler logs. stacktrace excerpt: 
```
Autoscaler: failed to create nodegroup: AttachRoleDenied: iam:PassRole denied for role arn:aws:iam::...:role/provisioner
Autoscaler: launchTemplate version v3 != expected v5 -> abort
```
Marta: confirmed — ASG scaling API calls are returning 403 for our autoscaler role. IAM condition appears to have been tightened in the last rollout (prob related to the org-wide policy change earlier today).
Carlos: also getting kubelet register errors once instances boot: 
```
kubelet: node registration failed: failed to map instance-profile -> token request unauthorized
```
Priya: customer impact: some inference endpoints returning 503/timeout and queued requests for >30s. Traffic to lower-priority batch jobs is being throttled by queue controller. Not a full outage but latency severe for realtime customers.
SRE-Oncall: I'm on it. Starting incident timeline channel and tagging EngInfra + CloudSec. Quick mitigation brainstorm: 1) manual ASG desired scale up (if we have quota) 2) temporary rollback of IAM condition 3) create a parallel nodegroup with a permissive launch template and attach role 4) evict low-priority pods / increase nodeSelector for critical pods -> route to other region 5) degrade to CPU-only fallback for non-critical models.
James: trying manual scale up now to buy time. Hitting launch template mismatch on create. I can spin up an on-demand instance via console with the older LT, attach the GPU AMI and join cluster — but that requires PassRole.
Marta: CloudSec — can you approve a short-lived PassRole exemption? tagging @CloudSec (not in thread)
incident-bot: CloudSec notified. escalation window 10m.
Carlos: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep Pending | wc -l` -> 412 pending. Top pending reasons: InsufficientGPU, NodeAffinity, TaintTolerationMissing.
Priya: plan A: get one nodegroup up manually with an older LT + existing role. plan B: if CloudSec can't expedite, we'll proactively scale down non-prod tenant jobs and change scheduler priority classes to drain GPU demand.
James: I can run this command to mark batch pods low priority: `kubectl annotate pods -n batch priority=low --selector=batch=true` then `kubectl delete pods -l priority=low -n batch --grace-period=0` to free resources. Doing it now.
Marta: I'm going to patch the nodegroup LaunchTemplate to match expected version v5 -> v5b and attempt create again. monitoring cloud api responses.
SRE-Oncall: update: CloudSec gave temporary PassRole allowance for 20m. James, proceed with manual create. Keep audit logs.
James: spun up 3 on-demand GPU instances with LT v5b and attached to cluster — nodes registered but kubelet failing on one due to taint mismatch: `node taint nvidia.com/gpu:NoSchedule` applied before kubelet ready. I'm removing the taint temporarily to allow critical pods to schedule: `kubectl taint nodes <node> nvidia.com/gpu-`
Carlos: after removing taint a few critical inference pods scheduled, latency improved for some endpoints. queue pending dropped from 412 -> 78 in 12m.
Priya: good. still seeing autoscaler errors in logs — looks like autoscaler IAM token requests are throttled/denied intermittently. need longer-term fix in infra.
Marta: creating a new nodegroup with updated launch template and correct attach role binding. Creating as spot-backed with capacity-optimized fallback to on-demand — that'll reduce cost while we stabilize.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — severity remains high. next on-call: SRE-Oncall -> Marta in 30m handoff.
SRE-Oncall: taking notes for postmortem: immediate causes: 1) recent IAM policy change tightened PassRole constraints 2) some nodegroups were still referencing older LT versions -> create fails 3) taints applied early led to scheduling delays once nodes registered. Secondary: autoscaler didn't have graceful retry for AttachRoleDenied.
Carlos: customer-facing status: partial degradation for realtime inference in prod-region-1. 503 rate ~2.4% across tenants, top affected customers: a small subset of high-throughput embed users. Recommend posting a status update: "Degraded performance for inference workloads in prod-region-1; mitigation in progress."
Priya: drafting status update and will include note about mitigation steps and ETA ~45-60m.
James: FYI I applied a short-term autoscaler config tweak increasing create retries and widening tolerated LT versions. Watching for side effects.
Marta: created new nodegroup successfully, autoscaler attached proper role and passed health checks. Nodes are joining and taints set after kubelet ready now. Pod scheduling stable. Pending queue down to 12.
Priya: great. can we close paging? SRE-Oncall / Marta to continue watch.
SRE-Oncall: leaving active monitoring on for 2 hours. Handoff to Marta in 30m. Logging for postmortem saved.
Carlos: items for follow-up (postmortem): 1) revert risky IAM change or define exception workflow 2) add autoscaler IAM test in canary for LT changes 3) make taint application post-kubelet-ready to avoid scheduling race 4) improve queue auto-throttling for fallback models 5) customer communication follow-up and credit assessment.
Priya: adding follow-up tickets and assigning owners. Thanks all. Closing thread when last_message_ts recorded. :white_check_mark:
OpsBot: Reminder set: #incidents postmortem template created: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-4897654321
Marta: last check: pending=0, GPU utilization 64%, latencies back to baseline for majority. Will keep monitoring.
SRE-Oncall: handoff complete -> Marta.
Marta: acknowledging handoff. I'll run through the postmortem checklist and include logs + timeline.
Priya: closing notes: duration ~1h8m, root cause: IAM policy roll tightened PassRole + LT drift + taint race. Customer impact: degraded latency and 503s for a subset of realtime users, no data loss. Mitigations: manual nodegroup creation, temporary PassRole exemption, taint removal for critical nodes, autoscaler retry tweak, and new LT nodegroup.
